children: LAUNCHES UAE'S FIRST IN-STORE DDSC PAYMENT PILOT FOR AED BACKED STABLECOIN TRANSACTIONS
PILOT MARKS THE FIRST LIVE DDSC STABLECOIN TRANSACTIONS AT THE POINT OF SALE IN THE UAE
NECUSTOMERS WILL BE ABLE TO PAY WITH DDSC STABLECOIN THROUGH NETWORK’S EXISTING POINT-OF-SALE INFRASTRUCTURE
QR-BASED PAYMENT JOURNEY IS DESIGNED TO PROVIDE MERCHANTS WITH SETTLEMENT OPTIONS IN DDSC OR UAE DIRHAMS
DDSC IS DEVELOPED THROUGH COLLABORATION BETWEEN IHC, FAB AND SIRIUS INTERNATIONAL HOLDING
DDSC IS PEGGED 1:1 TO UAE DIRHAM AND SETTLES ON ADI CHAIN
